title: stdlib/pso (std/swarm): swarm instance handles + an ask/tell API so callers can gate, parallelise and record candidates themselves
ok: OK: std/pso exposes pso:make / pso:ask / pso:tell! / pso:best / pso:export / pso:import over per-instance state (no globals), with rejected candidates recorded and velocity clamp + boundary handling; the legacy pso:init/pso:step! wrappers run over one default instance
